<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="20" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">9:41</text>
    <line x1="319" y1="15" x2="319" y2="20" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="324" y1="12" x2="324" y2="20" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="329" y1="9" x2="329" y2="20" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="344" cy="15" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="12" x2="347" y2="18" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="358" y="9" width="23" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="361" y="12" width="16" height="6" rx="1" fill="#18191F"/>
    <rect x="382" y="13" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#18191F"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="43,61 32,72 43,83" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="33" y1="72" x2="57" y2="72" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="32" y="137" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="36" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Create account</text>
    <text x="32" y="168" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">Join the community and get started.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Form -->
  <g>
    <text x="32" y="212" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Full name</text>
    <rect x="32" y="222" width="326" height="56" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="50" y="257" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="500" fill="#18191F">Jordan Lee</text>

    <text x="32" y="317" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Email address</text>
    <rect x="32" y="327" width="326" height="56" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="50" y="362" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="500" fill="#969BAB">jordan.lee@email.com</text>

    <text x="32" y="422" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Password</text>
    <rect x="32" y="432" width="326" height="56" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="50" y="467" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="500" fill="#969BAB">Enter your password</text>
    <circle cx="327" cy="460" r="4" fill="#969BAB"/>
    <circle cx="340" cy="460" r="4" fill="#969BAB"/>
    <line x1="321" y1="451" x2="346" y2="469" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="32" y="512" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">Use 8 or more characters with a mix of letters and numbers.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Primary action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="34" y="551" width="326" height="62" rx="16" fill="#18191F" opacity="0.16"/>
    <rect x="32" y="547" width="326" height="62" rx="16" fill="#FFBD12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="586" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Sign up</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Existing account -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="654" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">Already have an account?</text>
    <text x="195" y="680" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="#1947E5">Log in</text>
    <line x1="174" y1="684" x2="216" y2="684" stroke="#1947E5" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="742" width="390" height="102" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="743" x2="390" y2="743" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="39,775 50,766 61,775" fill="none" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="43" y="774" width="14" height="13" fill="none" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="50" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#969BAB">Home</text>

    <!-- Discover -->
    <circle cx="127" cy="776" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="134" y1="783" x2="141" y2="790" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="127" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#969BAB">Discover</text>

    <!-- Messages -->
    <rect x="196" y="767" width="22" height="16" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="201,783 201,789 207,783" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="202" cy="775" r="1.5" fill="#969BAB"/>
    <circle cx="207" cy="775" r="1.5" fill="#969BAB"/>
    <circle cx="212" cy="775" r="1.5" fill="#969BAB"/>
    <text x="207" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#969BAB">Messages</text>

    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="312" cy="772" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#1947E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="312" cy="785" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#1947E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="312" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#1947E5">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
